title: 第3章 收获第4章 回城钓鱼
content_zh:
张昊宇溜达了半个多小时，嘿，又逮到两只野兔，四只野鸡。
他把两只没死的野鸡收进空间养殖区，两只受伤的野兔也放了进去。
两只死了的野鸡和一只死野兔则被收进了空间仓库，然后继续往前走……
“用神识一瞧，欧买噶的，前面100米处的河边有一群野猪正在喝水、嬉戏呢……”
他用意念拿出一把装满子弹的三八大盖步枪，想了想，还是没开枪。
自己前世执行任务时，啥场面没见过？现在还有空间呢，怕啥！大不了就进空间呗。
“慢慢地朝野猪靠近，野猪听到动静，居然没往远处跑，反而掉头朝他跑了过来！
我去，这啥情况啊？送外卖的来吧，他心里激动得要命。”
“一头两百斤左右的公野猪，很快就离张昊宇只有四十米了，三十米，二十米……收！
公野猪瞬间消失，后面的野猪都懵了，停顿了一下。”
张昊宇趁机快速冲向野猪群，其他野猪想跑已经来不及了。
收！一头一百多斤的母野猪和四头六七十斤的小野猪，出现在了空间养殖场里。
“来到河边！捡了些干树枝，拿出火柴点着，然后神识进入空间仓库。用意念处理了一只野兔和一只野鸡，放在火堆旁边烤了起来！”
肉就烤熟了，张昊宇迫不及待地吃了起来！虽然没放调料和盐，但吃着还挺香的。
毕竟肚子咕咕叫，急需食物来填饱。不一会儿，一只野鸡和一只野兔就被他吃得一点不剩。
心里琢磨着，要是能有酒，再来根烟就更爽了！得再抓点猎物回城卖掉，买些生活用品，烟酒糖茶、调料衣服鞋子啥的……
休息片刻后，张昊宇继续前进，转悠了好几个小时，收获了23只野兔和27只野鸡。
就是没碰到大型猎物！瞅瞅天色渐晚，他又生了火，烤了三只野鸡和两只野兔，吃了两只野鸡，剩下的则收进了空间仓库里！
进了空间，喝了些灵泉水，又服下一滴灵液，开始修炼“玄天长生诀”。他感觉到身体有了变化，丹田内的灵气也增强了不少！
实力增强，力量和速度都有所提升。张昊宇心里一惊，这修炼速度也太快了吧？

仔细想想，可能是前世的灵魂本来就比原身强大很多的缘故！再加上灵泉水和灵液的功效！
张昊宇琢磨着，反正身体是在往好的方向发展，管它是啥原因呢！修炼结束后。
身体上又冒出了一层黑乎乎的油脂，臭烘烘的，他赶紧用意念把它处理掉！
喝了些灵泉水后，又练了一遍古武太极和八极拳，还有军体拳，修炼结束后就在空间里睡觉了。
这一觉睡得可真香，一觉醒来，用神识观察了一下外面，天还是黑漆漆的。
喝了些灵泉水，又服下一滴灵液，继续修炼结束。用意念把身体清理干净，出了空间，天色也微微亮了起来！
又生了火，烤了几只野鸡野兔，吃完后把剩下的收进空间仓库，然后继续往前走，用神识观察着周围的情况！
张昊宇继续向前溜达，又晃悠了一个多小时。突然听到野猪那惨绝人寰的叫声，难不成是野猪碰上大怪物了？啥玩意儿？
拿出三八大盖步枪，脚下生风地朝着声音传来的方向奔去。同时用神识扫视着前方。
走了五六分钟，前面一百米的山洼处，几头两百斤左右的大野猪，正中间围着十几头五六十斤到一百斤的小野猪！
两头野猪正和一个大家伙打得热火朝天，我去，这不是熊霸嘛，对对对，就是棕熊，一头五六百斤的大棕熊。
地上还躺着一头大野猪，双方你来我往打得，那叫一个激烈，真是太热闹了。
张昊宇赶忙停下来，找了个绝佳的位置，把枪往树杈上一架，左调右调，总觉得不太对劲。

content_en:
Zhang Haoyu wandered for more than half an hour and caught two more hares and four pheasants.
He took two alive pheasants into the space breeding area, and also put two injured hares in.
Two dead pheasants and a dead hare were taken into the space warehouse, and then continued to move forward...
"Use your spiritual sense to take a look. Oh my God, there are a group of wild boars drinking and playing by the river 100 meters ahead..."
He used his mind to take out a 38-gauge rifle loaded with bullets. After thinking about it for a while, he still didn't fire.
When you were on a mission in your previous life, what scene didn’t you see? There is still space now, so what are you afraid of! If possible, just enter the space.
“Slowly approaching the wild boar, when the wild boar heard the noise, it didn’t run far away, but turned around and ran towards him!
Let me go, what's going on? Come on, delivery man, he was so excited. "
"A male wild boar weighing about 200 kilograms was soon only forty meters away from Zhang Haoyu, thirty meters, twenty meters... hold on!
The male wild boar disappeared instantly, and the wild boars behind him were stunned and paused. "
Zhang Haoyu took the opportunity to rush towards the group of wild boars quickly. It was already too late for the other wild boars to run away.
receive! A female wild boar weighing more than 100 kilograms and four wild boars weighing 60 or 70 kilograms appeared in the space breeding farm.
"Come to the river! I picked up some dry branches, took out matches and lit them, and then entered the space warehouse with my consciousness. I used my mind to process a hare and a pheasant, and put them next to the fire to roast!"
The meat was cooked, and Zhang Haoyu couldn't wait to eat it! Although there is no seasoning or salt, it tastes quite delicious.
After all, my stomach is growling and I need food to fill it up. After a while, a pheasant and a hare were eaten by him.
I thought to myself, it would be even better if I could have wine and a cigarette! I have to catch some more prey and go back to the city to sell them, and buy some daily necessities, tobacco, wine, sugar, tea, spices, clothes, shoes, etc...
After a short rest, Zhang Haoyu continued to move forward and wandered around for several hours, harvesting 23 hares and 27 pheasants.
I just didn’t encounter any big prey! Seeing that it was getting late, he lit a fire again, roasted three pheasants and two hares, ate two pheasants, and put the rest into the space warehouse!
After entering the space, he drank some spiritual spring water, took another drop of spiritual liquid, and began to practice the "Xuantian Immortality Technique". He felt a change in his body, and the spiritual energy in his Dantian had also strengthened a lot!
Increased strength, strength and speed. Zhang Haoyu was shocked, wasn't this cultivation speed too fast?
If you think about it carefully, it may be because the soul in the previous life was much stronger than the original one! Plus the effects of spiritual spring water and spiritual liquid!
Zhang Haoyu thought, anyway, his body is developing in a good direction, no matter what the reason is! After the training is over.
Another layer of black grease appeared on his body, which smelled very bad. He quickly used his mind to get rid of it!
After drinking some spiritual spring water, I practiced ancient martial arts Tai Chi, Bajiquan, and Juntiquan again. After practicing, I went to sleep in the space.
I slept so soundly this time. When I woke up, I used my spiritual consciousness to observe the outside. It was still dark.
After drinking some spiritual spring water, taking another drop of spiritual liquid, the practice continued. I used my thoughts to clean up my body, and after leaving the space, the sky became slightly brighter!
I lit a fire again and roasted a few pheasants and hares. After eating, I put the rest into the space warehouse, and then continued to move forward, observing the surrounding situation with my spiritual consciousness!
Zhang Haoyu continued to wander forward for more than an hour. Suddenly I heard the wild boar's miserable cry. Could it be that the wild boar encountered a big monster? What the hell?
He took out his 38-gauge rifle and ran toward the direction of the sound with the wind at his feet. At the same time, he scanned the front with his spiritual consciousness.
After walking for five or six minutes, in the valley 100 meters ahead, there were several large wild boars of about 200 kilograms, surrounded by a dozen small wild boars ranging from 50 to 60 kilograms to 100 kilograms!Two wild boars were having a heated fight with a big guy. Let me go, isn't this a bully bear? Yes, that's right, it's a brown bear, a big brown bear weighing 500 to 600 pounds.
There was also a big wild boar lying on the ground. The two sides were fighting back and forth. It was a fierce fight. It was really lively.
Zhang Haoyu stopped quickly, found a perfect position, put the gun on the branch of the tree, and adjusted it left and right, but something felt wrong.
After walking for another ten meters, I finally found a suitable tree. There were several large branches three meters high.
